title: Harder eye of ender.
description: This datapack adds a harder eye of ender crafting recipe twhile still keeping it obtainable in normal survival.
body:
This datapack aims to make progression more enjoyable by requiring adventure this pack does this by making the eye of ender crafting recipe harder than the normal recipe while still making it obtainable in survival minecraft. I hope you can enjoy this pack.




Crafting recipe per one eye
- Heart of the sea, obtainable through buried treasure chests with a 100% chance
- Echo shard, obtainable in ancient cities with a 30% change to appear in chests
- Ominous trial key, obtainable in trail chamber vaults at 30% only when spawners activated with a ominous bottle 
- Blaze powder, really you dont know how to make blaze power while using this datapack?
- Enchanted golden apple, found litteraly everywhere look in mineshafts, spawners, trail chambers, buried treasure, ancient city the enchated golden apples should be the friends we've made along the way
- Prismarine shards, killing guardians and elder guardians drop between 0-2 and with looting three up to 5 shards, remember to bring milk and water breathing potions to remove potion effects and breath underwater
- Ghast tear, obtainable by killing ghasts, remember ghasts spawn the most in soul sand valleys
- Wind charge, obtainable by killing breezes and crafting the breeze rod into breeze charge
